recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If this behavior regresses, investigate the Kindling TableGenerator rendering path before changing fhir.ini or the StructureDefinition source classifications.
issue_request: FHIR-34143 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction asking that Structure tabs use the abstract flag for abstract types such as Base and BackboneType, and the interface flag for interface types such as CanonicalResource.
initial_application: The Jira comment records Kindling commit acffe7f as the application. That commit changed HL7/kindling TableGenerator.java so interface rows emit «I» linked to uml.html#interface and abstract rows emit «A» linked to uml.html#abstract. No FHIR core source commit mentioning FHIR-34143 was found, consistent with a renderer fix rather than a source-definition fix.
additional_context: The current FHIR core source classifies Base and BackboneType as active abstract infrastructure types in source/fhir.ini and classifies CanonicalResource and MetadataResource as interface resources. The CanonicalResource and MetadataResource StructureDefinition source files also carry the structuredefinition-interface extension. Current build.fhir.org rendering shows Base and BackboneType with «A» and CanonicalResource and MetadataResource with «I».
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The authoritative source classifications and the current rendered specification already match the Jira-requested correction, so a source edit would be redundant or would touch the wrong layer.
